donate.title: Support EVOLVE
donate.subtitle: EVOLVE is an open-source, community-driven project. Donations fund development, security reviews, and infrastructure.
donate.noSale: सार्वजनिक टोकन बिक्री योजनामा छ, तर आज यो अझै सुरु भएको छैन। दान असर्तमय र फिर्ता नहुने उपहार हुन्: तपाईंले कुनै टोकन, स्वामित्व शेयर वा आर्थिक प्रतिफल प्राप्त गर्नुहुन्न। तलको डिस्क्लेमर हेर्नुहोस्।
donate.securityNote: Security: always verify the full address character-by-character against this page (bookmark it). Addresses are never sent by email, DM, or screenshots. Match the network — funds sent on the wrong chain are usually unrecoverable.
donate.guidelines: Guidelines: use a dedicated wallet for donations — never your main hot wallet. Prefer Monero or Lightning if you want donor privacy. A small test transaction first is always a good idea.
donate.leaveNote: Leave a note (optional): want us to be able to thank you later? Leave your name, a message, and an optional contact (Telegram / email / X).

form.name: Name
form.success: Thank you! Your note has been sent.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

donate.seeDisclaimer: For full details, see DONATE.md and DISCLAIMER.md in the repository.
